decisions.reason: The source specifies the document destination for CRM Task 1 but does not change the deadline or general completion expectation for scheduled assignments.
The CRM document destination does not change the fallback rule for independently starting other available work.
Requiring CRM Task 1 to be completed in its document does not alter the requirement to mark completed tasks in ClickUp.
A same-message MODIFY already records that the CRM task must be completed in the designated Google document and adds the relevant Google Drive component; no further update or removal is required.
